name: Mizu Tenbin ~Nageki no Namida~
source:
In order to become a successor to the world's most prestigious conglomerate, main character must fulfill Don's unusual desire which is to collect all kinds of female bodily fluids. It's a dark world here, and it's possible to dispose of opposing persons calmly.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
